learning_outcomes.text: Electromagnetic interference and electromagnetic interference sources
Solution methods at the system design stage
Designing electronic systems that do not give problems or errors regarding electromagnetic compatibility
Understanding electromagnetic compatibility design constraints and ways to achieve designs that meet all conditions
Relationship between impedance matching and electromagnetic compatibility
Concepts of shielding, filtering, grounding, immunity, pollution

syllabus_topics: Electromagnetic interference and electromagnetic interference sources
